method: Current public provider documentation checked by independent read-only research and compared with local handlers/manifests. No provider login, live registration or delivery was performed.

sources.facts: Create an app from manifest; review workspace and settings.
Install to workspace and permission/approval boundary.
Slash commands from conversations; endpoint and signing verification.
Azure Bot, Single Tenant for new registrations, messaging endpoint and Microsoft Teams channel.
Manifest and 192x192 color/32x32 outline icons at ZIP root.
Apps > Manage your apps > Upload an app > Upload a custom app; tenant policy.
Public client Native App/Single page App; PKCE S256; scopes; code and token endpoints; exact registered callback.
User access-token acquisition and typical 2h expiration. Confidential clients require client authentication.
App passwords for third-party clients; guide uses direct current app-password route rather than unverified nested menu labels.
User authorization vs app-only client credentials.
Posting requires user token and write:statuses.
commands supported token type is Bot. Use Bot Token Scopes, not User Token Scopes.
oauth_config.scopes.bot commands and features.bot_user define an installable slash-command bot app.

limits: Mastodon /settings/applications redirected to sign-in; authenticated standard UI labels were not directly exercised. The guide states instance customization and links to official OAuth alternative.
Bluesky app-password screen is behind sign-in; direct route and official app-password guidance used.
X loopback callback acceptance was not established, so guide uses an owner-controlled registered HTTPS callback and manually copied return URL.
Teams stores link message but does not send Connector API reply; Lamp Refresh chat links is the confirmation.
X refresh tokens are not handled by Lamp; expiration/reconnect documented.

Original manifest omitted an explicit commands scope and bot user; final manifest declares both. Lamp requires no bot token and no Events API messaging subscription. Slash command from private conversation is the linking path.
